sources.snippet: DeepSeek-R1-Zero represents a distinct branch in the DeepSeek model family, focusing on pure reinforcement learning. Its capabilities and limitations informed the development of DeepSeek-R1, which incorporates cold-start data before RL to address issues like endless repetition and poor readability.
